workflow: A file-processing utility allocates a metadata record without initializing every field.
A platform-dependent metadata helper fills only part of that record, leaving some fields indeterminate.
The utility reads the untouched fields while determining the input data size or layout.
Memory instrumentation detects the uninitialized read and aborts the utility, causing the instrumented build to fail instead of generating the expected output.
summary: Partially initialized file metadata is consumed under memory instrumentation
decision_reason: The failure is an uninitialized metadata-record read caused by incomplete helper initialization. Existing clusters cover different mechanisms, such as uninitialized numeric storage or conversion-status data, and are not materially the same workflow.
